regulations.title: Food handling permit required from Alberta Health Services
regulations.summary: Any business that prepares, packages, or sells food to the public in Alberta (including a bakery selling packaged baked goods) needs a food handling permit from Alberta Health Services (AHS) before opening, and the permit must be renewed every year.
regulations.regulation_name: Food Regulation (Alberta Regulation 31/2006), under the Public Health Act
regulations.authority: Alberta Health Services (AHS) - Environmental Public Health
regulations.action_required: Submit a food handling permit application and facility/floor plans to AHS Environmental Public Health at least 14 days before opening, then pass the pre-opening inspection to receive the permit.
regulations.penalty_note: Operating a food establishment without a valid AHS food handling permit is an offence under the Public Health Act and can result in an order to stop operating and fines.
regulations.source_name: Alberta Health Services - Open a Business

regulations.title: Mandatory food handler certification for at least one staff member
regulations.summary: At least one person responsible for food handling at your Alberta location must complete a government-recognized food safety course before (or shortly after) opening, and keep the certificate on file for inspectors.
regulations.regulation_name: Food Regulation (AR 31/2006), s. 31 - food handler training requirement
regulations.authority: Alberta Health Services (AHS) / Government of Alberta
regulations.action_required: Enroll at least one food handler in a course from Alberta's list of recognized food safety courses before opening, and keep the completion certificate on-site.
regulations.penalty_note: AHS inspectors check for valid food handler certification; missing certification can delay permit issuance or lead to orders on inspection.
regulations.source_name: Government of Alberta - Recognized food safety courses

regulations.title: Pre-opening facility inspection by an AHS public health inspector
regulations.summary: Before AHS will issue your food handling permit, a public health inspector visits your kitchen or production facility to confirm equipment, plumbing, ventilation, and sanitation meet Alberta's standards, and can return for unannounced follow-up visits after opening.
regulations.authority: Alberta Health Services (AHS) - Environmental Public Health
regulations.action_required: Have your production facility fully built out, equipped, and clean, then schedule the AHS pre-opening inspection before selling any food.
regulations.penalty_note: A failed inspection blocks permit issuance until deficiencies are corrected and the facility is re-inspected.
regulations.source_name: Alberta Health Services - Starting a Food Business

regulations.title: Beverage container registration and deposit (if selling bottled or canned drinks)
regulations.summary: If your packaged food line includes a bottled or canned beverage (juice, kombucha, bottled water, etc.), every container sold in Alberta must be registered with the province's beverage container recycling program, with a refundable deposit and recycling fee collected on each unit.
regulations.authority: Beverage Container Management Board (BCMB) / Alberta Beverage Container Recycling Corporation (ABCRC)
regulations.action_required: Register your company and each beverage container type with ABCRC/BCMB, pay the initial deposit, and remit the per-container deposit and recycling fee on every unit sold in Alberta.
regulations.penalty_note: Selling unregistered beverage containers violates the Beverage Container Recycling Regulation and can lead to the product being pulled from sale and financial penalties.

regulations.title: No provincial sales tax registration needed in Alberta
regulations.summary: Alberta is the only province with no provincial sales tax (PST), so packaged food sold here doesn't require the separate provincial sales-tax registration step you'd need in Ontario, Quebec, or BC - you still need to be registered for federal GST, just not a provincial one.
regulations.regulation_name: Alberta has not enacted a provincial sales tax; only the federal Goods and Services Tax (GST) applies to sales here
regulations.authority: Tax and Revenue Administration, Alberta Treasury Board and Finance
regulations.action_required: No Alberta provincial sales tax registration is required; just confirm your federal GST registration is in place before selling.
regulations.penalty_note: Not applicable - this is a reassurance item rather than an enforcement risk, since Alberta levies no provincial sales tax.
regulations.source_name: Government of Alberta - Tax and Revenue Administration
